title_en: Apartment with Veranda for Sale in Lake View Residence, near Kosovare Street! €448,000
description_en: The apartment is located in one of the most sought-after residences in Tirana, Lake View Residence, near Kosovare Street. This area is known for its tranquility, and its proximity to the Artificial Lake park, offering a high quality of life for residents. Property Description: The apartment consists of a spacious and functional space, suitable for a family looking for comfort and luxury. The surface of 129.54 m² includes: A bright living room with direct access to the veranda; Spacious lounge and dining area; 2 bedrooms; 2 toilets with quality equipment; Small warehouse for optimal organization; Veranda: 20m2 Extra works have been done in the apartment, such as a central heating-cooling system, quality parquet, shutters, etc., as well as the furniture and lighting plan, with an architect. The apartment is sold together with a parking space on the -3rd floor of the residence, with a value of €40,000
